summary: Join our Data Protection and Intellectual Property Management Course to master the skills needed to protect your data and manage your intellectual property.
lede: Data protection and intellectual property management connects privacy controls with the ownership and use of information assets. For professionals working in privacy, information security, data governance, contracts, or intellectual property, the course covers mapping data flows, assessing privacy risks, documenting ownership, and selecting controls for access, disclosure, retention, and licensing.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for experienced professionals who already work with information, privacy, technology, innovation, contracts, or intellectual property and need a joined-up control model.
modules: Data Protection and IP Governance Foundations
Data Mapping and Privacy Risk Analysis
Data Protection and IP Strategy Reporting
prerequisites: You need practical exposure to at least one relevant area such as privacy operations, information security, data governance, contracts, research commercialization, or IP portfolio administration. The course uses case materials and structured templates, so you do not need to disclose confidential organizational data. Coding is not required. Advanced topics such as AI-assisted discovery and automated monitoring receive operational application treatment, while treaty interpretation and specialist legal analysis remain conceptual and should be validated with qualified counsel.
